items.t: 'Stick' cast, creators preview Season 2 of Owen Wilson-starring sports comedy
items.x: Owen Wilson, Rhea Seehorn and more of the cast and creators preview the second season of sports comedy "Stick," with new episodes released Wednesdays on Apple TV.

items.t: Ex-FBI officials accused of false statements about Hunter Biden press for dismissal of charges
items.x: Two ex-FBI agents charged with making false statements about Hunter Biden to Congress want the charges thrown out, saying the case is politically motivated.

items.t: Colorado man charged after allegedly breaking into Florida Popeyes for a social media stunt
items.x: Police said Matthew Klassen admitted, after being advised of his rights, that he entered the restaurant and filmed a video of himself inside.

items.t: Potential Binance 'hack' forces crypto firms to freeze $3 billion
items.x: The exchange, which described the situation as a "security issue," has temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals while it "conducts security checks, freezes funds, and works with law enforcement." I

items.t: 10 Tampa Bay Weather: Breezy conditions continue ahead of Sunday showers
items.x: Halloween looks mainly dry and warm across Tampa Bay before a front brings a better chance of showers on Sunday.

items.t: Justice Department issues subpoenas as Democratic candidate Mary Peltola denies role in Alaska ballot scheme
items.x: Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola denies involvement in putting another candidate on the Alaska ballot with the same name as the Republican candidate.

items.t: Here are the 25 holiday stations on SiriusXM this year
items.x: SiriusXM is spreading cheer with its 2026 holiday music lineup.

items.t: Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool reopens after months of closures, restoration controversy
items.x: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C. has reopened to the public after months of closures and controversy surrounding a restoration project.

items.t: Dominican appeals court revokes Wander Franco pardon in sex abuse case
items.x: An appeals court in the Dominican Republic on Thursday granted a request by prosecutors to revoke a judicial pardon previously awarded to Tampa Bay Rays shortstop Wander Franco after he was convicted for the sexual and psychological abuse…

items.t: GM settles $220M lawsuit for allegedly selling private driver data in Florida, other states
items.x: The settlement concerns allegations that GM had sold the information to data brokers, who sold it to insurance companies, who used it to set insurance rates.

items.t: 3 killed in helicopter collision that shut down part of an Oregon highway
items.x: Two helicopters collided near a small airport southwest of Portland, Oregon, killing all three people aboard.

items.t: Police said Sandra Birchmore's death was a suicide. Then the FBI accused a cop of murder.
items.x: A former Massachusetts police detective is being tried on charges that he killed a pregnant woman to hide that he had begun sexually abusing her when she was 15.

items.t: McDonald’s is bringing back Pokémon Happy Meals with mini box toys and trading cards
items.x: McDonald's will bring Pokémon back to the Happy Meal on Nov. 10, with a collection built around the franchise's 30th anniversary.

items.t: Tampa Bay families balance Halloween traditions with higher costs
items.x: Tampa Bay families are finding ways to keep Halloween traditions alive as candy, costumes and decorations put pressure on their budgets.

items.t: Tarpon Springs mosque rebuild draws opposition. One neighbor says the controversy doesn't reflect the community
items.x: Marc Washburn says the congregation has been a quiet, welcome presence in the neighborhood for more than a decade.

items.t: Florida U.S. Senate candidates make final push ahead of election
items.x: The November midterms is just days away. One key race on the ticket is the U.S. Senate race between Republican incumbent Ashley Moody and Democratic State Representative Angie Nixon.

items.t: Fanfiction website AO3 could be down for 'up to 4 weeks' after security incident
items.x: The organization that runs Archive of Our Own, a massive fanfiction website, says the site might be down for up to four weeks.

items.t: Tampa Police upping patrols in entertainment districts ahead of Halloweekend
items.x: The Tampa Police Department will be sending more resources to high-traffic areas and entertainment districts to prevent drunk driving and "reckless behavior" this Halloween weekend.

items.t: Local organizations offers free rides to boost voter turnout
items.x: The elections office said all voters are within five miles of an early voting site.

items.t: Justice Department issues new subpoenas over Alaska candidate controversy, AP source says
items.x: The Justice Department issued subpoenas in an investigation over an Alaska Senate candidate who shares a name with GOP incumbent Dan Sullivan, an AP source says.
